Definition: to trample; hence, to wash (properly, by stamping with the feet), whether literal (including the fulling process) or figurative
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wash (by treading), be washed, perform the work of a fuller; 1a) (Qal) washer, fuller, treader (participle); 1b) (Piel) to wash (garments, person); 1c) (Pual) to be washed; 1d) (Hothpael) to be washed out
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
